name: This Is Not A Love Letter
source:
Your name is Wilbur Soot.

You don't technically have an invite to this party, but technicalities have never kept you out of Las Nevadas. The air is cool, the night is young, and a hand penned letter is burning a hole in your pocket.

It is not a love letter, but you feel compelled to deliver it in person.

[from [url=https://asterhours.itch.io/this-is-not-a-love-letter]itch.io[/url]]
